title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 100.Recalls that methane has over 80 times the warming power of carbon dioxide in its first 20 years in the atmosphere; welcomes the fact that almost 160 countries have become signatories to the Global Methane Pledge and urges those EU Member States that have not yet joined the Pledge to do so; calls on all Parties to also include specific methane reduction targets in their NDCs; calls on the Commission to continue with its efforts under the Global Methane Pledge while taking into account global challenges and the relevant implications on industry and the Member States;
